Ryan Carniato is a frontend performance enthusiast and Fine-Grained Reactivity super fan. Author of the SolidJS UI library and MarkoJS Core Team Member, join us on today's The Secret Sauce as he takes us on a journey from playing in a band to becoming who he is today.
